title: X02CredibleSetVariantRow
description: One row of credible_set_variants.tsv: a variant's membership of a credible set, with the PIP the named method assigned and the effect allele the beta is relative to.

pip.description: Posterior inclusion probability FROM THE NAMED METHOD. A model output, recorded with its method; never re-read as P(causal).

effect_allele.description: MANDATORY. A beta without its effect allele is meaningless and inverts silently under a strand flip.

eaf.description: Effect-allele frequency; lets an ingestion detect allele flips instead of trusting harmonisation.
